description: Original continuous locomotion. -Z forward, right=-X; upper torso negative X leans forward. Air is a held travel pose, not a jump impulse. Weapon state is selected by runtime.

idle.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

walk.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

run.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

air.weapon_pose_note: Shaft head stays forward and raised; hook faces outward, away from the right-hand side of the body. Local shaft roll 180 degrees.

idle.weapon_pose_note: Forward blade tip preserved; local shaft rolled 90 degrees so the cutting edges face sky/ground in ready and movement poses.
